providerTemplate.title: Provider Templates
providerTemplate.tip: Manage provider templates shared by the Preset Catalog and the adapter wizard; built-in templates are read-only, custom templates take effect immediately in both places
providerTemplate.name: Provider Name
providerTemplate.modelsPlaceholder:
One model per line (or comma-separated), e.g.:
deepseek-chat
deepseek-reasoner
providerTemplate.sortOrderTip: Lower value comes first; leave empty to append after custom templates
providerTemplate.descPlaceholder: Template description, e.g. DeepSeek Chat/Code API

validation.idPattern: Only letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, max 64 chars
validation.baseUrlInvalid: Please enter a valid URL (starting with http:// or https://)
validation.fixErrors: Some fields failed validation. Please check and try again.

providerTemplate.deleteConfirm: Delete template "{name}"? It will disappear from both the preset catalog and the adapter wizard.
providerTemplate.deleteRemedy: If deleted by mistake, recreate a template with the same name under "Model Config → Provider Templates".
providerTemplate.availabilityHint: Click "Check Availability" to PING each provider's default URL and see which APIs are currently reachable
providerTemplate.hideConfirm: Remove the built-in template "{name}" from the default list? It can be restored anytime and does not affect adapters already created.
providerTemplate.hideUnavailableConfirm: About to hide {count} default templates detected as unavailable. Continue?
providerTemplate.templateIdNote: Technical ID of the template, immutable after creation; safe to leave as generated
